E0510

Raw crypto expert API used without `use core.crypto.expert` and/or outside `#Unsafe` — use `crypto.seal`/`open` instead (D-CRYPTOENV1)

What

Raw crypto expert API used without `use core.crypto.expert` and/or outside `#Unsafe` — use `crypto.seal`/`open` instead (D-CRYPTOENV1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0510

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0510: tests/ui/crypto_argon2id_literal_policy_e0510_precedence.stderr.

Error [E0510]: `core.crypto.expert.argon2id` requires an audited `#Unsafe` region
  --> tests/ui/crypto_argon2id_literal_policy_e0510_precedence.jet:7:17
    |
  7 |     _ :: expert.argon2id(password, [0], 8191, 0, 0, 15)
    |                 ^^^^^^^^
 Why: raw crypto primitives may only run inside an explicit expert-tier gate (I1)
 Fix: wrap the call in `#Unsafe("crypto expert: …") { … }` or use `crypto.seal`/`open` instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0510

Error [E2402]: `?` can't convert `CryptoError` into `Err` — no declared conversion exists
  --> tests/ui/crypto_argon2id_literal_policy_e0510_precedence.jet:7:17
    |
  7 |     _ :: expert.argon2id(password, [0], 8191, 0, 0, 15)
    |                 ^^^^^^^^
 Why: `?` uses the declared conversion rail; `CryptoError` can reach `Err` only through `impl CryptoError -> Err`
 Fix: add `impl CryptoError -> Err { … }` before this function, or change the return type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2402
